set.body: Goal: let layers over different row types coexist in one plot without encoding hacks. Current evidence: Plot[Row], Layer[Row], FacetSpec[Row], TrainedPlot[Row], and ResolvedLayer[Row] propagate one Row type through the whole pipeline even when a layer supplies its own data. Treat this as a design plus implementation slice. Acceptance: an existential or type-member-packed layer keeps each row type with its data, mapping, stat, and scale observations; plot-level data and mapping inheritance are explicit; plot-global scales train across packed layers; facet behavior for layers that do not share the facet row type is explicit; dropped-row provenance and inspectable trained output remain typed; erasure is confined to one packaging boundary; mixed-data conformance and JVM plus Scala.js tests pass.
set.title: Graphics: heterogeneous per-layer row types and facet policy
